records.jp: そうそう。だからね、服だけじゃなくてバッグの色も重要なの
records.en_original: Yeah, you've always got to make sure the color of your bag matches your clothes.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, you've always got to make sure the color of your bag matches your clothes.
records.en: Right. That's why the color of your bag matters too, not just your clothes.

records.jp: だよねぇ。最後の最後でチグハグになっちゃったら痛いもんね
records.en_original: I know, right? After all the work it takes to coordinate, you don't want to ruin it with a mismatched bag.
records.en_auxiliary: I know, right? After all the work it takes to coordinate, you don't want to ruin it with a mismatched bag.
records.en: I know, right? After all the work it takes to coordinate, you don't want to ruin it with a mismatched bag.

records.jp: でしょ？　最後の最後といえば靴を最後に決めるのもアウト。<CR>むしろ靴は一番最初だから
records.en_original: Speaking of not sticking the landing, some people choose their shoes last, but shoes should be the FIRST choice!
records.en_auxiliary: Speaking of not sticking the landing, some people choose their shoes last, but shoes should be the FIRST choice!
records.en: Exactly. And speaking of finishing touches, choosing your shoes last is no good.<CR>You should actually choose them first.

records.jp: あれっ？
records.en_original: That's...a change.
records.en_auxiliary: That's...a change.
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: あ、ヒナちゃん。おっはよー
records.en_original: Morning, Hina!
records.en_auxiliary: Morning, Hina!
records.en: Morning, Hina-chan!

records.jp: あの二人、仲直りしたの？
records.en_original: It seems like those two managed to patch things up.
records.en_auxiliary: It seems like those two managed to patch things up.
records.en: Did those two make up?

records.jp: そうみたい。ライムたちが見かけた時には、<CR>もうあんな感じだったよ
records.en_original: It sure does. They've been like that since we first saw them this morning.
records.en_auxiliary: It sure does. They've been like that since we first saw them this morning.
records.en: It seems so. By the time Lime and the others saw them,<CR>they were already like that.

records.jp: あ、日菜子ちゃんおはよー！
records.en_original: Oh, Hinako, good morning!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, Hinako, good morning!
records.en: Oh, Hinako-chan, good morning!

records.jp: おはよう。昨日の今日なのに仲直り早いね
records.en_original: Good morning. Looks like you two are getting along a lot better than you were yesterday.
records.en_auxiliary: Good morning. Looks like you two are getting along a lot better than you were yesterday.
records.en: Morning. You made up quickly, considering it was only yesterday.

records.jp: あの後、私たち、思ってることを包み隠さずに話し合ったんだ
records.en_original: After I finished your makeover, we talked things out without holding anything back.
records.en_auxiliary: After I finished your makeover, we talked things out without holding anything back.
records.en: After that, we talked openly about everything we were thinking.

records.jp: ほんと、しほり、まったく引かなくて大変だったわよ
records.en_original: It was a real pain. Shihori was determined to have a heart-to-heart with me, no matter what.
records.en_auxiliary: It was a real pain. Shihori was determined to have a heart-to-heart with me, no matter what.
records.en: Seriously, Shihori wouldn't back down at all. It was tough.

records.jp: それに圧倒されちゃって、つい……ね
records.en_original: Eventually she...wore me down.
records.en_auxiliary: Eventually she...wore me down.
records.en: I was overwhelmed, and I just...you know.

records.jp: それでさ……その、なんていうか、<CR>私にも誤解があったってわかって
records.en_original: Once I had a chance to talk to her, I...realized that I'd misunderstood a few things.
records.en_auxiliary: Once I had a chance to talk to her, I realized that I'd misunderstood a few things.
records.en: And...well, how do I put this?<CR>I realized I'd misunderstood some things too.

records.jp: その……しほりには、悪いことしちゃったな、って
records.en_original: And that...honestly, I'd treated her badly.
records.en_auxiliary: And that, honestly, I'd treated her badly.
records.en: I...felt like I'd done something awful to Shihori.

records.jp: 私ももっと周りを見ないといけないなって思えたの
records.en_original: I've learned that I need to be more sensitive to what I'm doing and how it impacts the people around me, too.
records.en_auxiliary: I've learned that I need to be more sensitive to what I'm doing and how it impacts the people around me, too.
records.en: And I realized I need to pay more attention to the people around me too.

records.jp: しほり……
records.en_original: Oh, Shihori...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, Shihori...
records.en: Oh, Shihori...

records.jp: ちょっとしたすれ違いだったんだよ
records.en_original: One little misunderstanding caused such a wide rift between us.
records.en_auxiliary: One little misunderstanding caused such a wide rift between us.
records.en: It was just a small misunderstanding.

records.jp: これからは、一方的に決め付けるんじゃなくて、<CR>ちゃんと本人ととことん話し合ってみることにしたわ
records.en_original: So, from now on, we're both going to try to see things from the other's viewpoint, instead of just our own.
records.en_auxiliary: So, from now on, we're both going to try to see things from the other's viewpoint, instead of just our own.
records.en: From now on, instead of deciding things on my own,<CR>I'm going to talk things through with the person directly.

records.jp: その……私が言いたいのはそれだけ
records.en_original: I just...wanted to tell you that.
records.en_auxiliary: I just...wanted to tell you that.
records.en: That's...all I wanted to say.

records.jp: そっか、仲直りできたみたいでよかったよ
records.en_original: I'm glad to see that you two worked things out.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm glad to see that you two worked things out.
records.en: I'm glad to see that you two worked things out.

records.jp: 三人のおかげだよ。<CR>本当にありがとね
records.en_original: It's all thanks to you three. Thank you so much.
records.en_auxiliary: It's all thanks to you three. Thank you so much.
records.en: It's all thanks to you three.<CR>Thank you so much.

records.jp: 私たちはちょっと背中を押しただけだよ
records.en_original: All we did is give you the little push you needed.
records.en_auxiliary: All we did is give you the little push you needed.
records.en: We only gave you a little push.

records.jp: これからも何か悩みごとがあったらユズたちを頼ってね！
records.en_original: Still, if you ever have any problems, you can count on us!
records.en_auxiliary: Still, if you ever have any problems, you can count on us!
records.en: If anything troubles you again, count on Yuzu and the others!

records.jp: ライムは、別に何も……
records.en_original: I...really didn't do much.
records.en_auxiliary: I...really didn't do much.
records.en: Lime didn't really do anything...

records.jp: ねぇ、しほり！　しほりが好きなブランドの新作出てるよ！
records.en_original: Hey Shihori! Your fav brand has a new product coming out today!
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, Shihori! Your fave brand has a new product coming out today!
records.en: Hey, Shihori! A new item from that brand you like is out!

records.jp: えっ、ホント！？
records.en_original: Huh, REALLY!?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh, REALLY?!
records.en: Huh, REALLY!?

records.jp: あ、えっと……
records.en_original: Er, um...
records.en_auxiliary: Er, um...
records.en: Er, um...

records.jp: ユズたちはいいから話してきなよ！
records.en_original: You don't have to worry about us, go talk to her!
records.en_auxiliary: You don't have to worry about us, go talk to her!
records.en: Don't worry about Yuzu and the others—go talk to her!

records.jp: うん、せっかく仲直りしたんだし
records.en_original: Yeah, you've finally patched things up, after all.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, you've finally patched things up, after all.
records.en: Yeah, you've finally patched things up, after all.

records.jp: ありがとう！
records.en_original: Thanks!
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks!
records.en: Thanks!

records.jp: ホントだ。最近忙しかったから、<CR>チェック怠ってたなぁ
records.en_original: You're not kidding! I've been so busy lately that I had no idea!
records.en_auxiliary: You're not kidding! I've been so busy lately that I had no idea!
records.en: You're right. I've been busy lately,<CR>so I hadn't checked.

records.jp: そうだ、オススメのアイテムが出てたんだけど見てみる？
records.en_original: By the way, did you want to check out that product I recommended? It is out now.
records.en_auxiliary: By the way, did you want to check out that product I recommended? It's out now.
records.en: Oh, there was an item I wanted to recommend. Want to see it?

records.jp: ホント？　じゃあ今日の放課後！
records.en_original: Really? Then let's go after schoool!
records.en_auxiliary: Really? Then let's go after school!
records.en: Really? Then let's go after school!

records.jp: うん、行こう行こう！
records.en_original: That would be great! Let's do it!
records.en_auxiliary: That would be great! Let's do it!
records.en: That would be great! Let's do it!

records.jp: とりあえず、一件落着……なのかな？
records.en_original: So, do you think this case is closed?
records.en_auxiliary: So, do you think this case is closed?
records.en: For now, I guess that is one case settled...?

records.jp: 相談は、まったく別の内容だった気がするけどね
records.en_original: Remember back when we thought she wanted to talk to us about a boy?
records.en_auxiliary: I feel like she came to us for advice on something completely different, though.
records.en: I feel like what she asked us about was something completely different, though.

records.jp: 何かあったら、また連絡来るんじゃないかな？
records.en_original: If something comes up, I'm sure she'll come to us again.
records.en_auxiliary: If something comes up, I'm sure she'll come to us again.
records.en: If something comes up, I'm sure she'll come to us again.

records.jp: 大丈夫かな……
records.en_original: I just hope we'll be able to help...
records.en_auxiliary: I just hope we'll be able to help...
records.en: Will she be okay...?

records.jp: ライムとしては、フラグメントが手に入るなら、<CR>なんでもいいんだけど
records.en_original: As long as we can acquire more Fragments, it's all the same to me.
records.en_auxiliary: As long as we can acquire more Fragments, it's all the same to me.
records.en: As far as Lime is concerned, anything is fine<CR>as long as we get a Fragment.

records.jp: ライム、ドライ過ぎない？
records.en_original: Gee, Lime, you're such a heart.
records.en_auxiliary: Gee, Lime, you're all business, aren't you?
records.en: Lime, aren't you a little too cold?

records.jp: あはは……
records.en_original: Ahahaha...
records.en_auxiliary: Ahahaha...
records.en: Ahahaha...
